sentences.en: We are suffering from a severe water shortage this summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天我们正遭受严重的水资源短缺。

sentences.en: Anyone who breaks this rule is liable to severe punishment.
sentences.zh: 任何人违反这条规则都可能受到严厉惩罚。

sentences.en: They say we are going to have a severe winter.
sentences.zh: 他们说今冬会非常严寒。

senses.zh: 严厉的，要求严格的：exacting standards；难以承受的，艰难的：difficult to endure
